cells.contract: Keep the five language crates repository-local and independent of all GUI, product and governance tools.
cells.next_action: Recheck Cargo metadata across the five language crates when dependencies change.
acceptance_criteria: Every supported crate and dependency resolves to the permitted package set.

cells.contract: Check common package version and MIT metadata for the Rust language and reference workspaces at the independent version line.
cells.next_action: Run the metadata mismatch and license checks before changing the package version.
cells.expected_artifact: Version and license checks against Cargo metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Missing packages or a mismatched consumer version are rejected.

cells.contract: Build the pinned Rust toolchain and locked workspace closure with the shared lean profile and target directory.
cells.next_action: Verify CLI and embedding binaries against pre-fetched lockfiles.
cells.expected_artifact: Locked, offline language build and test log.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace tests and strict Clippy complete using the pinned toolchain.

cells.contract: CI and contributors invoke named repository checks with platform-specific prerequisites. Historical CI receipts qualify only the job and revision recorded.

evidence.platform: Windows Server 2022 Datacenter x64, OS build 20348, MSVC

cells.next_action: Inspect the job matrix and run each changed group on its supported platform.
cells.expected_artifact: Platform-specific command listing and matching CI steps.
acceptance_criteria: Each named group resolves to executable commands and CI runs the relevant platform groups.

cells.contract: Exercise public Rust embedding, installed JS package entry points and the separate C# application through the shared operation fixture.
cells.next_action: Run the three independent consumer groups after changing a public boundary.
cells.validation_command: sh scripts/check.sh consumer && sh scripts/check.sh node-consumer && sh scripts/check.sh dotnet-consumer
cells.expected_artifact: Consumer reports for the embedded and worker entry points.
acceptance_criteria: The same shared success fixture yields the expected observable effect count, Fuel and value.

cells.contract: Keep normative guides linked to reproducible checks and preserve historical source, platform, version and acceptance conditions.
cells.next_action: Add an automated check of local Markdown links in the documentation index and acceptance archive.
cells.expected_artifact: A repeatable local-link check for the two indexes.
acceptance_criteria: A fixture with a removed local target causes the documentation check to fail.
cells.independent_reason: Editorial ownership and the preservation of dated records apply even to proposed capabilities before any implementation dependency exists.

cells.contract: Prepare a distributable Rust package set with versioned internal dependencies and installation from the release artifacts.
blockers: Registry publication policy and versioned inter-crate dependency policy are undecided.
cells.next_action: Specify the registry release policy, then verify packaging and offline installation in a clean consumer.
cells.expected_artifact: A release policy and reproducible clean-install verification.
acceptance_criteria: The exact packaged crate set passes dependency resolution and an independent installation smoke test.

cells.contract: Pin versioned semantic catalog and generated-program bytes across Rust and JS planners and compile representative fixtures through reference hosts.
cells.next_action: Run fixture comparisons and the independent package checks for every intentional contract change.
cells.validation_command: sh scripts/check.sh consumer && sh scripts/check.sh javascript
cells.expected_artifact: Reviewed catalog and program compatibility fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Both planners agree with the canonical bytes for the supported versions.

cells.contract: The standalone v1 tool validates the eight-domain inventory and derives hierarchy, evidence-backed readiness and dependency-aware task cards.
cells.next_action: Run catalog validation and exercise the query and refusal paths when adding a cell.
cells.expected_artifact: Validated catalog plus JSON task card from the Rust tool.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence drift, broken coverage or invalid mainline references fail validation and prevent a Ready card.
